document.abstract: A survey of current lighting practices of TV stations engaged in live color origination was requested by the Television Studio Lighting Committee of the SMPTE. Seven major categories were covered: General, Studios, Lighting Materials, Personnel, Instrumentation, Make-up, and Miscellaneous. The main purpose of the survey was to determine the areas where independent and affiliated stations could benefit from assistance and advice. It was planned that after these areas were defined, SMPTE Lighting Subcommittees would be assigned specific areas for investigation.
